steps.title: Service Process
steps.subtitle: You only need to complete 2 steps (payment & shipping), BOXIUM handles the rest

step1.title: Submit Application & Pay Online
step1.desc: Fill in card details, select service tier, confirm fees and terms, then complete payment via Stripe or Alipay HK

step2.title: Receive Confirmation
step2.desc: After successful payment, the system automatically sends a confirmation (in-app + email) with BOXIUM's shipping address, application details, and deadline

step3.title: Print Application & Ship Cards
step3.desc: Print the application form and ship your cards to BOXIUM's address (SF Express Station 852Z351) at your own cost

step4.title: BOXIUM Handles PSA Submission
step4.desc: After BOXIUM confirms receipt, we handle PSA declaration and professional packaging, with 2 monthly batches shipped directly to PSA USA

step5.title: PSA Grading in Progress
step5.desc: Cards are sent to PSA USA for official grading. Average grading time is 60–90 days (varies by service tier)

step6.title: Grading Complete
step6.desc: You'll be notified of the grade result and certificate number. If you paid in full at step 1, no additional payment is needed.

step7.title: Cards Returned
step7.desc: After payment confirmation, BOXIUM arranges to ship the graded cards back to you

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: What cards can be submitted for PSA grading?
faq.a1: PSA accepts all types of trading card games, including Pokémon TCG, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Magic: The Gathering, One Piece TCG, etc.
faq.q2: How do I choose a service tier?
faq.a2: Consider two factors: (1) Card market value — choose a tier with a max declared value higher than your card's market value; (2) Time needed — choose Express for faster grading.
faq.q3: How do I track progress after shipping?
faq.a3: Every status update will be notified via in-app messages and email. You can also log in to check the real-time status on the application detail page.
faq.a4: Payment is in two stages: (1) Full service fee paid when submitting; (2) After grading, if you paid in full at step 1, no additional payment is needed.
faq.q5: When would I need to pay a price difference?
faq.a5: Only when grading reveals the need to upgrade the service tier. If you chose the appropriate tier at submission, you typically won't need to pay any difference.
faq.q6: What if the grade is lower than expected?
faq.a6: PSA grading results are final. BOXIUM cannot intervene in grading. If you disagree, you can apply for a review through PSA's official channels (additional fees apply).
faq.q7: What if cards are lost or damaged?
faq.a7: Risk during shipping to BOXIUM is borne by the sender. We recommend using tracked shipping. If damage occurs due to BOXIUM's negligence after receipt, maximum compensation is limited to the service fee.
faq.a8: If payment hasn't been made (awaiting_payment status), you can cancel on the application detail page. Once payment is made and cards are submitted to PSA, cancellation is not possible.
